album.title: Your postcard album
album.text: Every place can be snapped in five kinds of weather, from a clear day to after the storm. Each one is a new postcard for your album, and raises more for the Village Fund.

level.title: Photographer level
level.text: Every postcard earns you experience. Going up a level brings flashbulbs and new looks for your postcards.

requests.title: The Noticeboard
requests.text: The villagers have pinned up little favours. Do them while you tidy for extra money for the Fund.

daily.title: The Daily Postcard
daily.text: A new postcard every day, the same for everyone. Come back each day to fill your stamp card.

travel.title: The Travel Office
travel.text: Posters of other villages that would love a visit from you, one day.

coach.loupe: New! The magnifying glass shows you where to look. It recharges as you tidy.
coach.score: From now on your postcards earn stamps. Be quick and careful for all three!
coach.combo: Quick fixes one after another count as a run, and a run earns more!
coach.flash: New! A flashbulb lights up everything that's left, just for a moment.
coach.zoom: Spread two fingers to zoom in close, or double-tap. Pinch to zoom back out.
